plainText:
Goh's Butterfree (Japanese: ゴウのバタフリー Go's Butterfree) is the sixth that Goh in the Kanto region, and his seventh overall.

==In animation==
===History===
==== ====
 
In Working My Way Back to Mew!, Goh found at Vermilion Forest and chased after him as Butterfree flew at the top of a large tree. Goh threw a at him, but missed as Butterfree was far too high for Goh to reach him. When Goh slipped and dropped his Poké Ball, Butterfree attempted to fly away, but kicked the Poké Ball directly onto Butterfree, resulting in its capture.

In A Snow Day for Searching!, Goh used Butterfree, Scorbunny, , , and several others to find a 's lost bone. When they came across the group of that stole the bone, Goh had Butterfree use to one of them.

In Panic in the Park!, Butterfree joined a group made up of Goh's other Pokémon, which came into conflict with another faction led by Goh's Darmanitan, which was made up of and Pokémon, after the food around Cerise Park had been stolen. Butterfree and combined their Stun Spore attacks, which were blocked by 's . As the battle escalated, Scyther took control of the Bug-type group, but the infighting ended when lost control of itself, causing Cerise Park to become flooded. Butterfree joined the rest of the Pokémon in saving Goh's three , allowing them to evolve into and clear the storm with .

In There's a New Kid in Town!, Goh enlisted the help of Butterfree and Venomoth by having them use Stun Spore to locate the invisible crying , as its crying was affecting all the Pokémon in the proximity, and its paralysis caused Sobble to reappear, but it kept crying until hugged the Water Lizard Pokémon to comfort it, which caused Sobble to fall asleep and stop crying.

In Big Brother to the Rescue!, Goh used Butterfree, along with other Pokémon in the park, to create a fountain so that Grimer and could live in Cerise Laboratory without dirtying the stream.
 
In This Could be the Start of Something Big!, Butterfree attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure. After that, Butterfree posed for a group photo with Goh, Ash, and the others.

===Personality and characteristics===
Butterfree is shown as being a helpful Pokémon for restraining its targets with his attack. He also proves useful whenever Goh requires aerial assistance such as searching for lost items or Pokémon. 

Butterfree is usually seen alongside , and they often combined their Stun Spore attacks together to cover a wider area whenever Goh deems it necessary. They also perform this combo on their own accord, seen when Butterfree and Venomoth used it during their confrontation with the - and Pokémon faction in Panic in the Park!.

Butterfree debuted in Battle Frontier Challenge: The Flute Cup!.

==Trivia==
Butterfree is Goh's first .
Butterfree is Goh's first Pokémon to have its gender confirmed.
Not including Goh's first partner Pokémon, Butterfree, along with , holds the record for the most appearances out of Goh's Pokémon, at 26 main series episodes.
